test_assigned_tab_shows_site_grouping.title: Verify the Assigned table lists one well-formed row per site

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and click Assigned Licenses.
steps.expected: The headers read No., Site / Device, License Item(SKU), Quantity, Issue Date, Expiry Date, License Key, Status.

steps.action: Read the site rows.
steps.expected: Each has a site name, reads All Licenses, a Quantity of the form assigned/total with assigned no more than total, and a Status of Enabled or Disabled.

test_multiple_sites_displayed.title: Verify the site rows are numbered 1 to N in order, one per site

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses and read the No. column of the site rows.
steps.expected: The numbers run 1, 2, ... N with no gap or repeat, and no site name repeats.

test_expand_site_shows_features.title: Verify expanding a site lists its feature licences and their quantities add up to the site's

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses and note the first site's Quantity (assigned/total).
steps.expected: A row reading All Licenses with a Quantity like 18/74.

steps.action: Click the expand arrow on that site.
steps.expected: Feature rows appear under it, each with a name, a Quantity like 1 / 6, an issue date, an expiry date and a licence key.

steps.action: Add the feature rows' assigned and total counts.
steps.expected: The sums equal the site row's assigned and total.

test_collapse_site_hides_features.title: Verify collapsing a site removes exactly the feature rows it showed

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses and click the expand arrow on the first site.
steps.expected: Feature rows appear under the site.

steps.action: Click the arrow again.
steps.expected: The feature rows are gone and the table has the same rows as before the expansion.

test_site_enable_toggle_visible.title: Verify each site's switch agrees with its Status column

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses and read each site row's switch and Status.
steps.expected: One switch per site row; a switch that is on sits beside Enabled, a switch that is off beside Disabled.

test_assigned_tab_retains_state_after_na.title: Verify the Assigned table shows the same site rows after leaving for Views and coming back

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses and note the site rows.
steps.expected: At least one site row.

steps.action: Click Views in the sidebar, then open Admin > Licenses and click Assigned Licenses again.
steps.expected: Assigned Licenses is selected and the site rows read the same as before.

test_assigned_tab_refresh_behavior.title: Verify the Assigned tab re-selects and shows the same site rows after a page reload

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses and note the site rows.
steps.expected: At least one site row.

steps.action: Reload the browser page, open Admin > Licenses and click Assigned Licenses.
steps.expected: Assigned Licenses is selected and the site rows read the same as before.

test_device_list_loads.title: Verify a feature licence opens its device list with a breadcrumb and device rows

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses, expand the first site and click a feature licence.
steps.expected: A device list opens under a breadcrumb naming the site and the feature.

steps.action: Read the device table.
steps.expected: A Device column and a Status column, and at least one device row.

test_device_list_has_three_dot_menu.title: Verify every device row carries an options menu

steps.action: Open a feature licence's device list.
steps.expected: The list shows its device rows.

steps.action: Count the three-dot options icons.
steps.expected: One per device row.

test_suspend_option_available.title: Verify a device's options menu offers Suspend and closes on Escape

steps.action: Open a feature licence's device list and click the first device's three-dot icon.
steps.expected: A menu opens listing Suspend.

steps.action: Press Escape.
steps.expected: The menu closes.

test_unassign_option_available.title: Verify a device's options menu offers Unassign and closes on Escape

steps.action: Open a feature licence's device list and click the first device's three-dot icon.
steps.expected: A menu opens listing Unassign.

steps.action: Press Escape.
steps.expected: The menu closes.

test_suspend_confirmation_popup.title: Verify Suspend asks for confirmation naming the action, and Cancel changes nothing

steps.action: Open a feature licence's device list, open the first device's menu and choose Suspend.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog opens whose text mentions suspending, with Cancel and a confirm button.

steps.action: Click Cancel.
steps.expected: The dialog closes and the device row reads as before.

test_unassign_confirmation_popup.title: Verify Unassign asks for confirmation naming the action, and Cancel changes nothing

steps.action: Open a feature licence's device list, open the first device's menu and choose Unassign.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog opens whose text mentions unassigning, with Cancel and a confirm button.

steps.action: Click Cancel.
steps.expected: The dialog closes and the device row reads as before.

test_assign_button_visible.title: Verify Assign New is offered on the Assigned tab and not on the Available tab

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses on the Available Licenses tab.
steps.expected: No Assign New button.

steps.action: Click Assigned Licenses.
steps.expected: A button reading Assign New is shown and enabled.

test_assign_modal_opens.title: Verify Assign New opens the assignment panel with its heading, both modes and its sections

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses and click Assign New.
steps.expected: A panel headed Assign New License opens, offering Assign to Bulk and Assign to Individual, a Site select reading Select, Features and Devices sections, and an Assign button.

steps.action: Press Escape.
steps.expected: The panel closes.

test_assign_modal_close_via_cancel.title: Verify Escape dismisses the assignment panel and frees the page

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses, click Assign New, then press Escape.
steps.expected: The panel is gone.

steps.action: Click Available Licenses.
steps.expected: The tab responds: Available Licenses becomes the selected tab.

test_site_dropdown_in_modal.title: Verify the panel's Site select lists the tenant's sites, including the configured one

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses, click Assign New and open the Site select.
steps.expected: The options are the placeholder Select followed by the tenant's site names, the configured test site among them, with no name repeated.

steps.action: Press Escape twice.
steps.expected: The list and the panel close.
